extra.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS amount FROM persons INNER JOIN countries ON countries.country = persons.citizenship INNER JOIN person_awards ON person_awards.person = persons.person INNER JOIN awards ON awards.award = person_awards.award WHERE sex = 'female' AND countries.name = 'People''s Republic of China' AND awards.name LIKE '%nobel%'
